content_metadata.title: MicroFuse: Protein-to-Genome Expert Fusion for Microbial Operon Reasoning
content_metadata.summary: This paper presents MicroFuse, a framework for predicting microbial operon co-membership by integrating protein-scale molecular identity and genome-context organization. It leverages a four-expert Mixture-of-Experts module to effectively model agreement and disagreement between these modalities.
